tasks.goal: Guide visitors along the Charter Hall exhibits, narrating the DAO charter, contribution model and measurable outcomes at each display panel.
tasks.terrain: Flat indoor exhibit floor of the campus conference centre; queue barriers, plinth edges and cabling ramps around display panels.
success: Visits all 5 exhibit waypoints in order
Dwell time 20-40 s per panel
Speech utterance per waypoint matches scripted charter text
Zero collisions with barriers or visitors
safety_stops: E-stop on human within 0.5 m
Stop if battery below 15%
Abort tour if speech engine fails twice consecutively
tasks.human_in_loop: A steward approves the final tour script and any edits to charter wording used in narration.

tasks.goal: Retrieve bound research summaries and evidence binders from library shelving and deliver them to the steward review desk.
tasks.terrain: Carpeted lab floor with library stacks, rolling ladders, desk chairs and low file boxes that intrude into aisles.
success: Grasp success rate >= 90% over 20 trials
Delivery within 0.3 m of desk drop zone
Zero dropped binders
Aisle traversal with <= 1 navigation replan per trip
safety_stops: Stop if gripper force exceeds threshold
Stop on unexpected human in aisle
E-stop if tilt > 10 degrees
tasks.human_in_loop: A person confirms each requested binder title before retrieval and signs off on delivery.

tasks.goal: Set up the proposal forum AV station: position microphones, route cables and stage the tablet podium for human debate and voting sessions.
tasks.terrain: Fixed dais with tiered seating, podium frame edges and under-floor cable ducts in the forum hall.
success: Mic placement within 2 cm of target pose on all 4 seats
Cable routed through duct with <= 1 snag
Podium tablet staged within 3 degrees of level
Cycle time under 8 minutes
safety_stops: Stop if end-effector wrench exceeds 40 N
Pause on human entering the dais workspace
Stop if joint velocity limit exceeded
tasks.human_in_loop: A steward verifies mic placement and activates the voting system before the session.

tasks.goal: Patrol the Operations Deck, reading task-board QR codes and status displays to report working-group progress to the Task Router.
tasks.terrain: Raised computer-room floor with cable trays, desk clusters and occasional trolley obstacles near the operations consoles.
success: Reads 8/8 QR stations per patrol lap
Lap completed in under 6 minutes
Slip or stumble events = 0
Status report published within 5 s of each scan
safety_stops: Low-battery return-to-dock below 20%
Stop on stair or drop-off edge detection
Stop if kicked or tipped
tasks.human_in_loop: A person reviews the compiled patrol report before it is posted to the task board.

tasks.goal: Survey the campus perimeter paths and riverbank edge to log ground conditions for the Progress Observatory's site-access progress log.
tasks.terrain: Grassland margins of the Cam river floodplain: soft riverbank mud, farm-track ruts, gate thresholds and seasonal wet patches.
success: Completes 1.2 km perimeter loop without manual recovery
Riverbank clearance >= 1.5 m maintained
Terrain classification logged at 1 Hz
Localization drift < 0.5 m over the loop
safety_stops: Stop if within 1 m of water's edge
Stop on roll > 15 degrees
Rover return on GPS fix loss > 10 s
tasks.human_in_loop: A steward approves riverbank route segments before each survey and reviews the condition log.

tasks.goal: Fly a short inspection swarm loop across the lab atrium ceiling lights and vent grilles, capturing images for maintenance triage.
tasks.terrain: High atrium with skylight glazing, ceiling light fixtures, vent grilles and occasional banner cables strung for exhibits.
success: Images captured of all 6 target fixtures
Hover position error < 10 cm at each target
Battery-landing reserve >= 20% at touchdown
Zero interventions from safety pilot
safety_stops: Land immediately on battery below 3.5 V
Avoid glazing by >= 0.5 m
Kill motors on loss of positioning > 2 s
tasks.human_in_loop: A person clears the airspace, acts as safety pilot with kill switch, and approves the image triage list.

tasks.goal: Lift and mount the charter display frame onto the exhibit wall, then verify verticality and anchor torque before human inspection.
tasks.terrain: Concrete exhibition hall floor with pallet staging area, forklift pallet edges and wall anchor points above plinth height.
success: Display mounted within 1 degree of vertical
Anchor torque within 10% of spec on all 4 bolts
Zero drops of the 15 kg frame
Balance perturbation under 5 cm CoM shift during lift
safety_stops: Stop if ankle torque exceeds limit
Release-and-hold on wrench spike > 150 N
Shutdown on fall detection
tasks.human_in_loop: A person inspects anchors, applies final torque and signs the exhibit off before visitors enter.

tasks.goal: Terminate sensor harness wiring for the Progress Observatory dashboard wall, inserting connectors into the sensor junction panel.
tasks.terrain: Workbench in the observatory gallery with cable spools, connector trays and a raised dashboard rail to reach over.
success: Connector insertion success >= 95% over 40 inserts
Insertion force within 5-15 N band
Zero reversed-polarity insertions (detected pre-insert)
Panel wiring map match 100%
safety_stops: Stop if Cartesian velocity > 0.1 m/s near panel
Reflex retreat on force > 20 N
Stop on human hand entering workspace envelope
tasks.human_in_loop: An engineer approves the wiring map and performs final continuity check before dashboard power-up.
